prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "Select how you want your companion to interact with your desktop daily."]
1: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Companion", "Master essential desktop pet gestures before jumping in.", "Right-click your pet anytime for actions and settings menu", "Click and drag to position your pet anywhere on your screen", "Ready to Play"]
2: ["Upload High-Quality Pet Photos", "Clear, well-lit photos ensure your custom pet renders cleanly on your desktop.", "Avoid blurry photos or heavy shadows for best results", "Select Clear Photos"]
3: []
4: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion's official record to finalize adoption.", "Official Desktop Companion"]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "Setting up your companion's desktop environment.", "Tip: You can hide or mute your pet anytime from the tray menu."]
6: ["You can change your companion's path and personality settings anytime later."]
7: ["Sign In to Save Your Companion", "Use your primary sign-in method so your pet data and progress stay synced across sessions.", "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with the same account to restore your companion."]
8: ["Your Companion is Now on Your Desktop!", "Look around your screen! Your pet is active. Click and drag to position them anywhere, or right-click to open actions.", "Start Interacting"]
9: ["Pick Your Companion", "Choose a friend to receive complimentary starter items and toys.", "Free Starter Accessory Pack Included"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions complimentary gifts and free extras
